verify_checksums: verify that expected file checksums match recorded checksums and raise errors on mismatches
verify_splits: verify that expected dataset splits match recorded splits and validate split sizes
get_size_checksum_dict: compute the file size and optional sha256 checksum for a given file path
is_small_dataset: check if a dataset size in bytes is smaller than the in memory max size config
use_verification_mode: configure dataset verification using ALL_CHECKS, BASIC_CHECKS, or NO_CHECKS enum values
